record.name: Tanzania
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. An April 2026 parliamentary answer says a national strategy for safe AI use has been prepared.

next_check.reason: Routine re-check on a two-year rotation of states with no reported plans.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. The retrieved material does not sufficiently establish the national AI governance arrangements. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

Re-ran searches in English and Swahili for a government-designated institute that evaluates advanced models, or a commitment, proposal or study naming one. No qualifying institute or commitment was identified; the Swahili query returned no relevant results. Reviewed the parliamentary answer as primary governance evidence. Raised confidence to medium under the status-confidence rule: recorded queries in English and a national or official language, and cited primary governance evidence consistent with no qualifying institute. Partial check; the last full-check date is unchanged.

check.language_note: The recorded sw query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. Preserved result batches, using 1-based positions in check.searches: TZ-search = searches 1, 2 (en, sw). Each multi-query batch has only a combined returned result set; its source_ids cannot be attributed to individual queries. Historical query dates are recorded as 17 October 2026 in the phase6 search-boundary ledger. On 24 October 2026 the record was searched again in English and Swahili; the result links of each query were matched against registered sources in the same way.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: An April 2026 government answer in the National Assembly says a national strategy for safe AI use has been prepared and that a national digital technology institute is planned for training in emerging technologies. Neither is described as evaluating advanced models.

record.notes: A parliamentary answer on 22 April 2026 says that a national strategy for safe AI has been prepared and a digital-technology institute is planned for training. Publication of the strategy was not verified in the retrieved sources. Searches covered indexed public English and Swahili sources for a government-designated AI safety institute with a remit to evaluate advanced models.

excerpts.text: Serikali imeandaa Mkakati wa Kitaifa wa matumizi salama ya Teknolojia ya akili mnemba
excerpts.gloss: The government has prepared a national strategy for safe use of AI technology.

excerpts.text: Serikali inakamilisha taratibu za kuanza ujenzi wa Taasisi ya Taifa ya Teknolojia ya Kidijiti katika eneo la Nala – Jijini Dodoma, ambayo itajikita katika utoaji wa mafunzo kwa teknolojia zinazoibukia ikiwemo akili mnemba.
excerpts.gloss: The government is completing procedures to begin building the National Institute of Digital Technology at Nala in Dodoma, which will focus on training in emerging technologies including AI.
